# hostd_vm_firewall_rule (Resource)

One VM firewall rule, or an attached security group. The firewall filters the public interface. Rules are evaluated by `position` from 0; rules of one VM must be applied in that order (`depends_on`). `type = group` attaches a security group: `action` is its `pve_group_name`. Import with `<project_id>,<vmid>,<position>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hostd_vm_firewall_rule" "ssh" {
  project_id = hostd_vm.web.project_id
  vmid       = hostd_vm.web.vmid
  position   = 0
  type       = "in"
  action     = "ACCEPT"
  proto      = "tcp"
  dport      = "22"

  depends_on = [hostd_vm_firewall_options.web]
}

resource "hostd_vm_firewall_rule" "web" {
  project_id = hostd_vm.web.project_id
  vmid       = hostd_vm.web.vmid
  position   = 1
  type       = "group"
  action     = hostd_security_group.web.pve_group_name

  depends_on = [hostd_vm_firewall_rule.ssh]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) `ACCEPT` or `DROP` for a packet filter. For `type = group`, the security group's `pve_group_name`.
- `position` (Number) Zero-based position. Changing it moves the rule.
- `project_id` (String) UUID of the project the VM belongs to.
- `type` (String) `in` or `out` for a packet filter, or `group` to attach a security group.
- `vmid` (Number) VM identifier (`hostd_vm.vmid`).

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Free-text comment. Empty by default.
- `dest` (String) Destination address, CIDR, IPv4 range, or an IP set as `+<pve_ipset_name>`. Same limits as `source`.
- `dport` (String) Destination port, range (`80:85`) or list. TCP and UDP only.
- `enable` (Boolean) Whether the rule is enabled. Defaults to true.
- `proto` (String) `tcp`, `udp` or `icmp` for a packet filter. Leave empty for a security group.
- `source` (String) Source address, CIDR (IPv4 no larger than `/26`, IPv6 no larger than `/64`), IPv4 range, or an IP set as `+<pve_ipset_name>`.
- `sport` (String) Source port, range (`80:85`) or list. TCP and UDP only.
